question: Which opened workspace exports should appear in unqualified completion?
decision: Add explicit exports from every other opened module to the unqualified completion fallback, after local declarations and direct-import exports, while suppressing duplicate names.

query.receiver: plain unqualified identifier prefix without a member or qualified path
query.sources: current module declarations, direct-import exports, and explicit exports from other opened modules
query.precedence: current module and direct imports before workspace candidates
query.duplicates: workspace names already present in earlier candidate sources are omitted
query.ordering: existing completion name, source ID, source start, source end ordering

compatibility_boundary.receiver_modes: member and qualified completion retain their existing restricted candidate sets
compatibility_boundary.visibility: private declarations and closed or disk-only modules remain excluded

quantitative_gate: tests/lsp_tests.py covers a local hel prefix and an exported helper from another opened module.
out_of_scope: private declarations from other opened modules
workspace candidates for member or qualified paths
